label: Good
corporate_parent: Shaw Industries Group, Inc. — subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
manufacturing_location: Dalton, GA and multiple US facilities

veneer_specification.refinishing_cycles: Screen and recoat only — not full sanding. 2mm is the threshold.

core_construction.description: Standard plywood core with cross-grain construction. Adequate but not premium substrate.

finish_system.description: ScufResist Platinum — UV-cured aluminum oxide with enhanced scuff resistance. Competent standard grade.

water_resistance.description: Repel water-resistant technology — edge and surface treatment for enhanced moisture resistance. Genuine engineering — provides meaningful protection against spills and minor moisture exposure.

milling_precision.description: Standard milling — Shaw's scale provides consistency but not precision-grade. Adequate for professional installation.

performance_evidence.refinishing_potential: Screen and recoat only — 2mm veneer does not support full sanding. Limits long-term longevity.
performance_evidence.moisture_resistance: Enhanced — Repel technology provides meaningful water resistance beyond standard engineered.
performance_evidence.installation_versatility: All methods — glue, nail/staple, float. Maximum subfloor compatibility.

structural_warranty.description: Lifetime residential structural with Berkshire Hathaway backing

durability_evidence.warranty_claim_process: Dealer-supported through Shaw's extensive retail network

platform_disclosure.cross_brand: Shaw Industries / Anderson Tuftex share manufacturing platform. Report must disclose.
